design.title: Latent.pk — Investor Pitch Deck
design.reference: Robinhood investor day deck + Stripe.com dark sections + Linear product pages

slides.title: Cover — Latent.pk
slides.task_brief:
COVER SLIDE for an investor pitch deck. Pure dark fintech premium aesthetic.

Canvas: 1280x720, dark navy (#0A0E1A). Background should have a subtle decorative layer: a large green glow orb in the top-right (using class 'glow-orb green', positioned around top:-180px right:-180px, size ~600px), and a smaller blue glow orb bottom-left (using class 'glow-orb blue'). Also include a 'grid-bg' layer for the faint 40px grid pattern. All decorative layers must have z-index:0 and pointer-events:none; the content sits on top with z-index:1.

Content (verbatim):
- Top-left brand mark: a small green dot (12px circle, background var(--accent)) next to the wordmark 'Latent.pk' in Inter 700, 18px, white. Letter-spacing -0.01em.
- Top-right meta line: 'INVESTOR DECK · 2026' in Inter 600, 11px, color var(--muted-2), letter-spacing 0.12em, uppercase.
- Vertical center block (left-aligned, padding-left 72px):
  * Eyebrow pill: 'PRE-SEED ROUND' in a green accent-pill.
  * Hero wordmark (display size, 96px Inter 800, color var(--primary), letter-spacing -0.04em, line-height 0.95): 'Latent.pk'
  * One-line tagline below (Inter 500, 28px, color var(--primary), max-width 820px, margin-top 24px): 'Turning “what stock should I buy” into “here's the plan to reach your goal.”'
  * Sub-tagline (Inter 400, 17px, color var(--muted), margin-top 16px, max-width 740px): 'AI-driven, goal-based investment intelligence for the Pakistan Stock Exchange.'
- Bottom-left (above the page-mark): a thin horizontal accent bar (4px tall, 56px wide, background var(--accent), border-radius 2px).

Page-mark (bottom): left = 'LATENT.PK', right = '01 / 14'. Use class 'page-mark'.

No image URLs. Pure typography + CSS only.

slides.title: The Pakistan Moment — Vision / Hook
slides.task_brief:
VISION / HOOK SLIDE. Dark canvas. The slide sells the investor on the macro thesis in one punch.

Background: subtle 'grid-bg' layer + a single green glow-orb positioned top-right (around top:-150px, right:-120px, size 480px).

Top strip (left-aligned, padding-left 72px, padding-top 56px):
- Eyebrow pill 'THE THESIS' in accent-pill style.

Main headline (Inter 800, 56px, color var(--primary), line-height 1.05, letter-spacing -0.02em, max-width 980px, margin-top 24px):
'Pakistan's retail capital is ready. The interface isn't.'

Supporting paragraph (Inter 400, 17px, color var(--muted), line-height 1.55, max-width 880px, margin-top 28px):
'240 million people. $7B+ in Roshan Digital Account inflows since 2020. 110M+ smartphone users. Yet fewer than 100,000 Pakistanis actively trade on the PSX. The demand for participation is no longer the question — what's missing is a product that meets retail investors where they actually are.'

Bottom strip (3-column stat row, margin-top 56px, gap 32px, padding 0 72px):
Each stat is in a surface-1 card with 24px padding, border-radius 14px, height ~120px:
  Stat 1:
    - kpi number (font-num, 44px, 700, accent color): '240M'
    - label below (Inter 500, 13px, color var(--muted), letter-spacing 0.08em, uppercase): 'TOTAL POPULATION'
    - sub (Inter 400, 12px, color var(--muted-2), margin-top 4px): '5th largest country globally'
  Stat 2:
    - kpi number (44px, 700, accent): '$7B+'
    - label: 'RDA INFLOWS (2020-2024)'
    - sub: 'Overseas Pakistani digital investment'
  Stat 3:
    - kpi number (44px, 700, color var(--danger)): '<100K'
    - label: 'ACTIVE PSX RETAIL TRADERS'
    - sub: 'Out of 260K CDC accounts'

Page-mark: left = 'LATENT.PK · THE THESIS', right = '02 / 14'.

slides.title: Problem 1 — The Participation Gap
slides.task_brief:
PROBLEM SLIDE #1 — The PSX Retail Participation Gap. Dark canvas.

Background: 'grid-bg' + a small red-tinted glow-orb top-right (use inline style: background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,92,92,0.4) 0%, rgba(255,92,92,0) 70%); positioned top:-120px right:-100px; 380px wide; opacity 0.45; filter blur 80px).

Top strip:
- Eyebrow: 'PROBLEM 01 / 03' in a danger-pill (red tint).
- Headline (Inter 800, 44px, color var(--primary), line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -0.02em, margin-top 16px, max-width 1100px):
  'Pakistan has 240 million people. Less than 0.05% actively invest in its stock market.'

4-column stats grid (margin-top 40px, gap 20px, padding 0 72px). Each card is surface-1, 24px padding, height ~140px, border-radius 14px:
  Card 1:
    - kpi (font-num, 48px, 700, var(--primary)): '240M'
    - label (Inter 600, 12px, var(--muted), letter-spacing 0.08em, uppercase): 'TOTAL POPULATION'
    - sub (Inter 400, 12px, var(--muted-2)): '5th largest country'
  Card 2:
    - kpi (48px, 700, var(--primary)): '260K'
    - label: 'CDC INVESTOR ACCOUNTS'
    - sub: 'Registered retail accounts'
  Card 3:
    - kpi (48px, 700, var(--danger)): '~85K'
    - label: 'ACTIVE RETAIL TRADERS'
    - sub: 'Estimated, trades per quarter'
  Card 4:
    - kpi (48px, 700, var(--danger)): '0.034%'
    - label: 'PARTICIPATION RATE'
    - sub: 'Adults actively investing'

Supporting copy block (margin-top 36px, padding 0 72px, max-width 1100px):
Paragraph (Inter 400, 15px, color var(--muted), line-height 1.6):
'For context: India has 100M+ active demat accounts. Vietnam's retail participation tripled between 2018 and 2023. Pakistan's retail capital still flows through real estate, gold, and informal savings — assets that protect capital but fail to compound. The PSX remains a venue for institutions and a small pool of insiders, not a mass-market wealth engine. Latent exists to close this gap.'

Page-mark: left = 'LATENT.PK · PROBLEM 01', right = '03 / 14'.

slides.title: Problem 2 — Literacy & Time Barriers
slides.task_brief:
PROBLEM SLIDE #2 — Even interested investors can't act. Dark canvas. Split layout: left 56% text, right 44% visual diagram.

Background: 'grid-bg' + small red glow-orb top-left (inline style: background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,92,92,0.32) 0%, rgba(255,92,92,0) 70%); top:-100px left:-80px; 360px; opacity 0.4; blur 70px).

Left column (padding-left 72px, padding-top 56px, width ~620px):
- Eyebrow: 'PROBLEM 02 / 03' in danger-pill.
- Headline (Inter 800, 40px, var(--primary), line-height 1.1, margin-top 16px, max-width 580px):
  'Even interested investors can't act on it.'
- Body paragraph (Inter 400, 15px, var(--muted), line-height 1.6, margin-top 20px, max-width 560px):
  'Pakistan's financial literacy rate is 27% — among the lowest measured globally (S&P Global FinLit Survey). The average working professional in Karachi or Lahore has the savings but lacks the time to read balance sheets, track corporate actions, and time entries. PSX disclosure is improving, but raw filings aren't a strategy. Information without synthesis is noise — and noise costs people money.'
- Below body, a 2x2 mini-stats grid (margin-top 32px, gap 16px, max-width 540px). Each item is surface-1, 16px padding, height ~76px:
  Item A: kpi '27%' (var(--danger), 28px, 700, font-num) + label 'FinLit rate (S&P Global)' (Inter 500, 11px, var(--muted), uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em)
  Item B: kpi '80+ hrs' (var(--danger), 28px) + label 'To manually analyze one KSE-100 stock'
  Item C: kpi '0' (var(--danger), 28px) + label 'Licensed robo-advisors in Pakistan'
  Item D: kpi '6.5%' (var(--danger), 28px) + label 'Bank deposit rate — barely beats inflation'

Right column (absolute right:0, top:0, width:560px, height:720px, padding:80px 72px 80px 40px). A vertical 'signal-to-noise' diagram built in pure CSS:
- A column of 6 horizontal bars stacked vertically, each 38px tall, width 100%, gap 6px, border-radius 6px. From top to bottom, the bars represent increasing noise:
  Bar 1: width 100%, background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%), label overlay (Inter 600, 13px, var(--bg)): 'Company filings'
  Bar 2: width 92%, background: rgba(0,230,118,0.75), label: 'Technical indicators'
  Bar 3: width 84%, background: rgba(0,230,118,0.55), label (color var(--primary)): 'Macro data'
  Bar 4: width 70%, background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18), label (var(--primary)): 'Broker research'
  Bar 5: width 58%, background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12), label: 'Twitter/X chatter'
  Bar 6: width 45%, background: rgba(255,92,92,0.35), label (var(--primary)): 'WhatsApp tip groups'
- Below the bars, a small caption (margin-top 16px, Inter 500, 12px, var(--muted-2), text-align center, letter-spacing 0.05em, uppercase):
  'INFORMATION HIERARCHY → FROM SIGNAL TO NOISE'
- A small footnote below caption (Inter 400, 11px, var(--muted-2), margin-top 6px, text-align center):
  'Latent filters the bottom 4 layers. Investors only see the top.'

Page-mark: left = 'LATENT.PK · PROBLEM 02', right = '04 / 14'.

slides.title: Problem 3 — Existing Solutions Fall Short
slides.task_brief:
PROBLEM SLIDE #3 — Three places Pakistanis go for stock ideas. All three fail. Dark canvas. 3-column comparison.

Background: 'grid-bg' + a faint red glow-orb bottom-right (inline style: background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,92,92,0.3) 0%, rgba(255,92,92,0) 70%); bottom:-140px right:-120px; 420px; opacity 0.4; blur 80px).

Top strip (padding 56px 72px 0):
- Eyebrow: 'PROBLEM 03 / 03' in danger-pill.
- Headline (Inter 800, 40px, var(--primary), line-height 1.15, letter-spacing -0.02em, margin-top 16px, max-width 1100px):
  'Three places Pakistanis go for stock ideas. All three fail them.'

Three columns (margin-top 40px, padding 0 72px, gap 24px). Each column is a surface-1 card, border-radius 14px, padding 28px, height ~360px, display flex column:

Card 1 — WhatsApp tip groups:
  - Top: a Material Icon (class 'material-icons lg', color var(--danger)): 'forum'
  - Title (Inter 700, 22px, var(--primary), margin-top 12px): 'WhatsApp tip groups'
  - Tagline (Inter 400, 13px, var(--muted), margin-top 6px): 'Herd-sourced tips. No accountability.'
  - hr divider (margin-top 20px)
  - Bullet list (margin-top 18px, gap 10px, font-size 13.5px, var(--muted), line-height 1.5). Each bullet has a small red dot (8px circle) prefix:
    · Pump-and-dump risk is structural
    · No risk profiling or suitability
    · No plan, no exit, no accountability
    · Often illegal under SECP unlicensed advice rules

Card 2 — TradingView + raw charts:
  - Top: Material Icon (color var(--warning)): 'show_chart'
  - Title: 'TradingView + raw charts'
  - Tagline: 'Pro tools. Built for traders who already know.'
  - hr divider
  - Bullets:
    · Dumps data, not decisions
    · 70+ indicators with zero synthesis
    · No Pakistan-specific context (corp actions, tax)
    · Requires 100+ hours of training to use well

Card 3 — Broker apps:
  - Top: Material Icon (color var(--accent)): 'account_balance'
  - Title: 'Broker apps'
  - Tagline: 'Arif Habib, AKD, Foundation — execution venues.'
  - hr divider
  - Bullets:
    · Built for order placement, not advice
    · No goal-based planning
    · No risk-calibrated recommendations
    · UX optimized for traders, not first-time investors

Below the 3 cards (margin-top 24px, padding 0 72px, text-align center):
A single line in Inter 600, 18px, var(--accent): 'None of them turn “what stock should I buy?” into “here's the plan to reach your goal.”'

Page-mark: left = 'LATENT.PK · PROBLEM 03', right = '05 / 14'.

slides.title: Market Size — TAM / SAM / SOM
slides.task_brief:
MARKET SIZE SLIDE — TAM/SAM/SOM. Dark canvas. Split layout: left 52% text + numbers, right 48% visual.

Background: 'grid-bg' + green glow-orb top-right (top:-180px right:-160px; 540px; opacity 0.5).

Left column (padding 56px 0 0 72px, width ~660px):
- Eyebrow: 'MARKET SIZE' in accent-pill.
- Headline (Inter 800, 42px, var(--primary), line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -0.02em, margin-top 16px, max-width 620px):
  'A $60B+ addressable retail wealth pool by 2030.'
- Sub (Inter 400, 15px, var(--muted), line-height 1.55, margin-top 18px, max-width 620px):
  'If Pakistan's retail participation rate converges to even half of India's current level, the addressable retail capital on PSX grows by an order of magnitude in the next five years.'

Three stacked layers below (margin-top 36px, gap 14px, max-width 620px). Each is a surface-1 card with a colored left border (4px), padding 18px 22px, border-radius 12px:
  Layer 1 (border-left: 4px solid var(--accent)):
    - Top row: 'TAM' (Inter 700, 12px, var(--accent), letter-spacing 0.12em) on left; kpi '$60B+' (Inter 700, 28px, var(--primary), font-num) on right
    - Body (Inter 400, 13px, var(--muted), line-height 1.5, margin-top 6px):
      'Projected retail investable wealth in Pakistan by 2030. Assumes participation rate converges toward 50% of India's current level.'
  Layer 2 (border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-2)):
    - Top row: 'SAM' / '$14B'
    - Body: 'Digital-reachable: 8-10M Pakistanis with smartphones, bank accounts, and disposable income above PKR 100K/month.'
  Layer 3 (border-left: 4px solid var(--warning)):
    - Top row: 'SOM (36 months)' / '$420M AUM'
    - Body: 'Capturing 0.5% of SAM via subscription + tiered AUM fees by Q4 2028. Conservative; assumes 12.5% free→paid conversion.'

Right column (absolute right:0 top:0, width:580px, height:720px, padding:80px 72px 80px 40px):
A vertical 'inverted pyramid' / concentric market visualization built in pure CSS:
- Three stacked horizontal bars centered vertically. Top bar widest, bottom narrowest.
- Bar 1 (TAM): width 440px, height 90px, background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,230,118,0.18) 0%, rgba(0,230,118,0.06) 100%), border 1px solid rgba(0,230,118,0.4), border-radius 14px 14px 0 0. Center text: '$60B TAM' (Inter 700, 22px, var(--accent)) with sub 'Projected retail wealth 2030' (Inter 500, 11px, var(--muted), uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em) below.
- Bar 2 (SAM): width 320px, height 78px, background: rgba(0,230,118,0.08), border 1px solid rgba(0,230,118,0.25). Text: '$14B SAM' (Inter 700, 18px, var(--accent-2)) + sub 'Digital-reachable today'.
- Bar 3 (SOM): width 200px, height 70px, background: rgba(251,191,36,0.1), border 1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.35). Text: '$420M SOM' (Inter 700, 16px, var(--warning)) + sub '36-month target'.
- All three bars are centered horizontally and stacked with 4px gap.
- Below the pyramid (margin-top 32px), small caption (Inter 500, 11px, var(--muted-2), text-align center, letter-spacing 0.08em, uppercase):
  'SOURCES: SECP ANNUAL REPORT · PSX FACTBOOK · SBP RDA STATISTICS · AUTHOR ESTIMATES'

Page-mark: left = 'LATENT.PK · MARKET', right = '06 / 14'.

slides.title: Why Now — Five Tailwinds
slides.task_brief:
WHY NOW SLIDE — five tailwinds converging. Dark canvas. Bento grid with 5 tiles.

Background: 'grid-bg' + green glow-orb top-right (top:-160px right:-140px; 480px; opacity 0.5).

Top strip (padding 56px 72px 0):
- Eyebrow: 'WHY NOW' in accent-pill.
- Headline (Inter 800, 42px, var(--primary), line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -0.02em, margin-top 16px, max-width 1100px):
  'Five tailwinds converging for the first time.'
- Sub (Inter 400, 15px, var(--muted), line-height 1.55, margin-top 14px, max-width 980px):
  'The infrastructure for mass retail investing in Pakistan is now in place. The window to build the intelligence layer on top opens once.'

Bento grid (margin-top 36px, padding 0 72px). CSS grid: 3 columns × 2 rows, gap 16px. Tile arrangement (3-col, 2-row):

  Tile B (col 2, row 1): Raast instant payments
  Tile C (col 3, row 1): SECP digital onboarding
  Tile D (col 1, row 2): Smartphone saturation
  Tile E (col 2-3, row 2, spans 2 cols): PSX digitization

Each tile is surface-1, border-radius 14px, padding 22px. Inside each tile:
  - Top: Material Icon (class 'material-icons lg', color var(--accent))
  - Title (Inter 700, 18px, var(--primary), margin-top 10px)
  - KPI line (Inter 700, 22px, var(--accent), font-num, margin-top 6px)
  - Body (Inter 400, 12.5px, var(--muted), line-height 1.5, margin-top 8px)

Tile A — Roshan Digital Account:
  Icon: 'public'
  Title: 'Roshan Digital Account'
  KPI: '$7B+ inflows'
  Body: 'Overseas Pakistanis have already proven they will invest digitally. The demand signal is banked.'

Tile B — Raast instant payments:
  Icon: 'bolt'
  Title: 'Raast instant payments'
  KPI: 'Live nationally'
  Body: 'Real-time settlement infrastructure for fund transfers and (soon) brokerage settlement.'

Tile C — SECP digital onboarding:
  Icon: 'verified_user'
  Title: 'SECP digital onboarding'
  KPI: 'KYC APIs live'
  Body: 'e-Sahulat, digital account opening, and broker KYC APIs now mandated. Onboarding friction falling fast.'

Tile D — Smartphone saturation:
  Icon: 'smartphone'
  Title: 'Smartphone saturation'
  KPI: '110M+ users'
  Body: '4G/5G coverage at 80%+ population penetration. Mobile-first distribution now viable.'

Tile E (wide, spans 2 cols) — PSX digitization:
  Icon: 'trending_up'
  Title: 'PSX digitization'
  KPI: 'KSE-100 mobile-accessible · fractional shares in discussion'
  Body: 'The exchange itself is now accessible via mobile-first interfaces, with fractional share ownership under active regulatory review. The plumbing for mass retail is built — what is missing is the intelligence layer that turns raw PSX data into a plan.'

Page-mark: left = 'LATENT.PK · WHY NOW', right = '07 / 14'.

slides.title: Solution — Latent.pk
slides.task_brief:
SOLUTION SLIDE — Latent turns market noise into a plan you can follow. Dark canvas.

Background: 'grid-bg' + green glow-orb top-right (top:-200px right:-180px; 580px; opacity 0.55) + smaller green glow-orb bottom-left (bottom:-120px left:-80px; 380px; opacity 0.35).

Top strip (padding 56px 72px 0):
- Eyebrow: 'THE SOLUTION' in accent-pill.
- Headline (Inter 800, 46px, var(--primary), line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -0.02em, margin-top 16px, max-width 1100px):
  'Latent turns market noise into a plan you can follow.'
- Sub (Inter 400, 16px, var(--muted), line-height 1.55, margin-top 16px, max-width 980px):
  'Latent is not a brokerage. It is an intelligence layer that translates the complexity of the Pakistan Stock Exchange into a clear, personalized action plan — calibrated to each investor's risk profile, time horizon, and financial targets.'

3-column pillars grid (margin-top 40px, padding 0 72px, gap 22px). Each pillar is surface-1, border-radius 14px, padding 28px 26px, height ~260px:

Pillar 1 — Signal over noise:
  - Top: a large numeral (Inter 800, 64px, var(--accent), font-num, line-height 1, opacity 0.9): '01'
  - Title (Inter 700, 22px, var(--primary), margin-top 12px): 'Signal over noise'
  - Body (Inter 400, 13.5px, var(--muted), line-height 1.55, margin-top 10px):
    'Predictive algorithms digest 200+ data sources per candidate stock — corporate filings, technical patterns, macro signals, sentiment, and on-the-ground broker research. Noise is filtered before the investor ever sees the output.'

Pillar 2 — Plan over tip:
  - '02'
  - Title: 'Plan over tip'
  - Body: 'Every output is a goal-based, time-bound, risk-calibrated plan — not a single-stock tip. Allocation sizing, entry strategy, review cadence, and exit triggers are all built in. The investor follows a plan, not a hunch.'

Pillar 3 — Personalized over generic:
  - '03'
  - Title: 'Personalized over generic'
  - Body: 'Risk tolerance, time horizon, financial targets, and liquidity constraints drive every recommendation. Two investors with the same capital can receive materially different plans because they have materially different lives.'

Page-mark: left = 'LATENT.PK · SOLUTION', right = '08 / 14'.

slides.title: Product Flow — How It Works
slides.task_brief:
PRODUCT FLOW SLIDE — 4-step horizontal timeline. Dark canvas.

Background: 'grid-bg' + green glow-orb bottom-center (bottom:-180px left:50%; transform translateX(-50%); 520px; opacity 0.4).

Top strip (padding 56px 72px 0):

- Headline (Inter 800, 42px, var(--primary), line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -0.02em, margin-top 16px, max-width 1100px):

- Sub (Inter 400, 14px, var(--muted), line-height 1.5, margin-top 12px, max-width 1000px):

Timeline (margin-top 56px, padding 0 72px). 4-step horizontal timeline built in pure CSS:
- A container with display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: stretch.
- Above each step tile, a small horizontal connector: a 1px line (var(--border)) spans across, with a 14px green circle (background var(--accent), box-shadow 0 0 16px var(--accent-glow)) at each step's center top.
- Each step is a surface-1 tile, padding 24px 20px, border-radius 14px, flex:1, height ~320px:

Step 1 — Risk Profiler:
  - Top number (Inter 800, 48px, var(--accent), font-num, opacity 0.85): '1'
  - Title (Inter 700, 18px, var(--primary), margin-top 6px): 'Risk Profiler'
  - Time chip (margin-top 10px): a small inline pill (background var(--accent-dim), color var(--accent), Inter 600, 11px, padding 4px 10px, border-radius 999px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em): '~90 SECONDS'
  - Body (Inter 400, 13px, var(--muted), line-height 1.55, margin-top 14px):
    'Seven-question onboarding captures risk tolerance, time horizon, financial goals, and liquidity needs. Algorithmic scoring replaces subjective self-assessment.'

Step 2 — AI Plan Generation:
  - '2'
  - Title: 'AI Plan Generation'
  - Time chip: '~60 SECONDS'
  - Body: 'Latent synthesizes 200+ signals per candidate security, then constructs a personalized portfolio plan: target allocation, entry strategy, position sizing, and review cadence. Plans are explainable, not black-box.'

Step 3 — One-Click Execution:
  - '3'
  - Title: 'One-Click Execution'
  - Time chip: '~30 SECONDS'
  - Body: 'Broker-integrated order routing via partner brokers (Singular, Arif Habib, Foundation Securities). The user reviews and approves; the plan executes automatically across the selected broker.'

Step 4 — Goal Tracking:
  - '4'
  - Title: 'Goal Tracking'
  - Time chip: 'ONGOING'
  - Body: 'Daily plan-health monitoring, rebalancing alerts, milestone tracking, and exit triggers. The investor sees goal progress, not just portfolio P&L — purpose re-anchored to outcomes.'

Page-mark: left = 'LATENT.PK · PRODUCT', right = '09 / 14'.

slides.title: Comparison — Latent vs. Alternatives
slides.task_brief:
COMPARISON SLIDE — feature matrix table. Dark canvas.

Background: 'grid-bg' + small green glow-orb top-right (top:-120px right:-100px; 360px; opacity 0.4).

Top strip (padding 48px 72px 0):
- Eyebrow: 'COMPETITIVE LANDSCAPE' in accent-pill.
- Headline (Inter 800, 38px, var(--primary), line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -0.02em, margin-top 14px, max-width 1100px):
  'What “here's your plan” actually means.'
- Sub (Inter 400, 13.5px, var(--muted), line-height 1.5, margin-top 10px, max-width 980px):
  'No incumbent in Pakistan combines AI-driven signal, goal-based planning, and integrated execution. Latent is the only player that closes the loop from question to plan to outcome.'

Matrix table (margin-top 28px, padding 0 72px). CSS table with 5 columns and 7 data rows. Use HTML table element styled via inline classes/Tailwind. The Latent column should be visually highlighted.

Table structure: 5 columns × 8 rows (1 header + 7 data).
Header row: column titles, sticky look:
  Col 1 (left): 'CAPABILITY' (Inter 700, 11px, var(--muted-2), uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em)
  Col 2: 'WhatsApp tips' (Inter 600, 13px, var(--muted))
  Col 3: 'TradingView' (Inter 600, 13px, var(--muted))
  Col 4: 'Broker apps' (Inter 600, 13px, var(--muted))
  Col 5: 'Latent.pk' (Inter 700, 13px, var(--accent), background: var(--accent-dim), border-radius 8px, padding 6px 0)

Data rows (each row: row hover, padding 14px 0, border-bottom 1px solid var(--border), col 1 = Inter 500, 13.5px, var(--primary), other cols = Inter 500, 13.5px, centered text):
Cells use either a red × (Material Icon 'close', color var(--danger), font-size 18px) or a green check (Material Icon 'check_circle', color var(--accent), font-size 18px) or a small muted dot (Material Icon 'remove', color var(--muted-2), font-size 18px) for partial.

Row 1 — Risk profiling:
  WhatsApp: × | TradingView: × | Broker: × | Latent: ✓
Row 2 — Goal-based plan:
  × | × | × | ✓
Row 3 — Predictive AI signals:
  × | dot (tools only) | × | ✓
Row 4 — PSX-native data depth:
  dot (variable) | dot (limited) | ✓ | ✓
Row 5 — One-click execution:
  × | × | ✓ | ✓
Row 6 — Goal tracking & rebalancing:
  × | × | × | ✓
Row 7 — Accountability / audit trail:
  × | × | dot (broker only) | ✓
